name: muon-core-tester
description: Development test helpers for validating muon through CDP.

scripts.test: npm run build:target --workspace muon-core -- test Release linux64 && npm run build:target --workspace muon-core -- test Debug linux64 && vite build && npm run test:vitest
scripts.test:ffi-closures: npm run build:target --workspace muon-core -- test Release linux64 && npm run build:target --workspace muon-core -- test Debug linux64 -DMUON_TRACK_FFI_CLOSURES=ON && vite build && MUON_EXPECT_FFI_CLOSURE_TRACKER=1 npm run test:vitest
scripts.test:asan: npm run build:target --workspace muon-core -- test Release linux64 && npm run build:target --workspace muon-core -- test Debug linux64 -DMUON_TRACK_FFI_CLOSURES=ON && vite build && MUON_EXPECT_FFI_CLOSURE_TRACKER=1 npm run test:vitest && npm run build:target --workspace muon-core -- test Debug linux64 -DMUON_TRACK_FFI_CLOSURES=ON -DMUON_ENABLE_SANITIZERS=ON && ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1:halt_on_error=1:abort_on_error=1 LSAN_OPTIONS=exitcode=23 xvfb-run -a node ../scripts/run-xvfb-command.mjs ctest --test-dir ../muon-core/.build/test/linux64/debug --output-on-failure -R '(plugin_api_header|traffic_type_metadata|traffic_bridge)_sanitizer'
scripts.test:valgrind: npm run build:target --workspace muon-core -- test Release linux64 && npm run build:target --workspace muon-core -- test Debug linux64 -DMUON_TRACK_FFI_CLOSURES=ON && vite build && MUON_EXPECT_FFI_CLOSURE_TRACKER=1 npm run test:vitest && xvfb-run -a node ../scripts/run-xvfb-command.mjs valgrind --tool=memcheck --leak-check=full --show-leak-kinds=definite,indirect --errors-for-leak-kinds=definite,indirect --error-exitcode=97 --track-origins=yes --trace-children=no ../muon-core/.build/test/linux64/debug/muon_plugin_api_header_test && xvfb-run -a node ../scripts/run-xvfb-command.mjs valgrind --tool=memcheck --leak-check=full --show-leak-kinds=definite,indirect --errors-for-leak-kinds=definite,indirect --error-exitcode=97 --track-origins=yes --trace-children=no ../muon-core/.build/test/linux64/debug/muon_traffic_type_metadata_test && xvfb-run -a node ../scripts/run-xvfb-command.mjs valgrind --tool=memcheck --leak-check=full --show-leak-kinds=definite,indirect --errors-for-leak-kinds=definite,indirect --error-exitcode=97 --track-origins=yes --trace-children=no ../muon-core/.build/test/linux64/debug/muon_traffic_bridge_test
